style: Flat 2D cartoon illustration from a printed children's picture book: bold clean dark outlines, flat bright colors with simple soft cel shading, large round expressive eyes, simple friendly shapes, a clear uncluttered background. Flat 2D artwork like a storybook page. Not 3D, not a render, not clay, not a photo, not a pencil sketch, not watercolor.
sheet: Full body, standing, front view, on a plain white background. No words or letters.
rules: Describe hair and clothes only. Never describe skin color or ethnicity (Daniel, 2026-10-01). People keep the printed picture-book look.
